synopsis: Gazebo is a free, Apache 2.0 open-source robotics simulator providing physics, rendering, camera, lidar, IMU and plugin-defined sensors, with supported ROS 2 integration [f15915, f8525, f8526, f8708]. Release information lists Jetty LTS from September 2025 with support to 2031, and Gazebo Sim 10.5.0 released on 29 July 2026 [f9051, f8528]. The proposed lowest-cost open-source chain uses Gazebo or alternatives for sensors and environments, Chrono for machine dynamics and SCM terrain, and ROS 2; low license costs come with high internal labor and remaining hardware and cloud costs [f16158, f16128, f8739]. Expert opinion characterizes Gazebo as an integration framework requiring extensions for automotive-grade radar, weather, material modeling and enterprise validation management [f8529]. The research did not verify Gazebo or find off-road collision-warning validation, off-road evidence or heavy-machine automatic-braking proof, so its listed capabilities do not establish suitability for this validation task [f5850, f5851, f9047, f8530]. Despite the stated release-support horizon, project funding, maintenance and security-patch cadence were not examined [f15931, f9392, f9393].
